summary.claim_boundary: Recorded real Nemotron decisions were evaluated on isolated loopback HTTP incidents. Playback sends no requests. R34, R36, R37 and R38 used the same contract but different cases within one simulator. R35's interface regression and R38's 4/8 abstention failure are shown in full. No production reliability, target edge hardware, or public live route was verified.
